name: sofya
label: Sofya
description: Web tools for AI agents: search the web, fetch pages as clean markdown, extract structured data with AI, and run deep multi-source research.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Sofya API Key:

1. Visit [Sofya](https://sofya.co) and create an account (sign up with GitHub for 1,000 free credits per month on most accounts).
2. Open your [dashboard](https://sofya.co/dashboard).
3. Copy your API key (it starts with `ay_live_`).

search.label: Search the Web
search.description: Search the web and get full page content, not just snippets.

search_depth.label: Search Depth
search_depth.description: "basic" fetches pages and returns extracted content (3 credits). "snippets" returns SERP snippets only, without fetching pages (1 credit).

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Use "news" for current events, breaking news, or any time-sensitive query.

include_answer.label: Include Answer
include_answer.description: Add an AI-synthesized answer based on the search results (adds 5 credits).

freshness.label: Freshness
freshness.description: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".

include_domains.label: Include Domains
include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (max 10).

extract.label: Extract Data from Page
extract.description: Use AI to pull specific data from a webpage — pricing, specs, contacts, and more.

url.label: URL
url.description: The URL to extract information from.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: What information to extract (e.g. "list all pricing tiers with features").

research.label: Deep Research
research.description: Research any topic — searches up to 30 sources and synthesizes a cited report.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Use "news" to prioritize recent news articles.

max_sources.label: Maximum Sources
max_sources.description: Maximum number of sources to use (5-30).

freshness.label: Freshness
freshness.description: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".
